UPTICK.gloss: a transaction in the stock market at a price above the price of the preceding transaction
UPTICK.definition: A transaction in the stock market at a price above the price of the preceding transaction.

TICK.example: He counted the ticks of the clock.

PUCK.gloss: a vulcanized rubber disk 3 inches in diameter that is used instead of a ball in ice hockey
PUCK.definition: A vulcanized rubber disk 3 inches in diameter that is used instead of a ball in ice hockey.

TUCK.example: Insert your ticket into the slot.

PUT.gloss: put into a certain place or abstract location
PUT.definition: Put into a certain place or abstract location.

CUP.gloss: a small open container usually used for drinking
CUP.definition: A small open container usually used for drinking; usually has a handle.
CUP.example: He put the cup back in the saucer.

CUT.gloss: separate with or as if with an instrument
CUT.definition: Separate with or as if with an instrument.

TIP.definition: The extreme end of something; especially something pointed.

KIT.gloss: a case for containing a set of articles
KIT.definition: A case for containing a set of articles.

PIT.definition: A sizeable hole (usually in the ground).
PIT.example: They dug a pit to bury the body.

PIC.gloss: a form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving…
PIC.definition: A form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving the illusion of continuous movement.
PIC.example: They went to a movie every Saturday night.
